create_training_sampler: create a TrainingSampler to produce an infinite stream of shuffled dataset indices for distributed training
create_random_subset_training_sampler: create a RandomSubsetTrainingSampler to sample a random subset of indices by a given ratio for training
create_repeat_factor_training_sampler: create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler to sample indices with stochastic repeat factors for class imbalanced datasets
compute_repeat_factors_from_category_fre: compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency using RepeatFactorTrainingSampler.repeat_factors_from_category_frequency
create_inference_sampler: create an InferenceSampler to produce shard indices for inference across distributed workers
